scope: Talvora 2026-Q3 deep modernization: .NET 10, MCP SDK, NuGet reproducibility, GitHub Actions, development quality gates, and polished tray-owned Windows desktop progress reporting.

libraries.verified: Current ASP.NET Core MCP server registration and HTTP transport patterns; AddCallToolFilter wraps every CallTool request and exposes request.Params.Name while preserving downstream cancellation/exception semantics.
Current Microsoft.Extensions.AI and Microsoft.Extensions package alignment guidance for .NET 10.

Current NuGet Central Package Management, package lock/locked restore, NuGet audit and global.json SDK pinning guidance; NamedPipeServerStream/NamedPipeClientStream are the current .NET IPC primitives and support async/cancellation; bounded Channel<T> provides nonblocking producer/consumer delivery patterns.

Current WPF-UI Snackbar guidance confirms presenter-owned nonmodal notification UX with explicit timeout; Talvora keeps the existing WPF-UI design language while using a tray-owned WPF progress card so full text, coalescing, hover pause and lifecycle remain under Talvora control.

Current WPF guidance confirms Window.DragMove is the native borderless-window drag mechanism while the left mouse button is pressed; Topmost and borderless transparent windows remain supported. Talvora uses DragMove for direct card repositioning, persists the user's pinned anchor, and restores it against the current monitor work area.
